OrderRecord.title: OrderRecord
OrderRecord.description: A customer fountain pen and bottled ink purchase placed on PENS R US Kenya with live order tracking status.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the customer who placed the order.

userEmail.description: The email address of the authenticated user.

orderStatus.description: Current fulfillment and courier tracking status of the order.

trackingCode.description: Kenya courier tracking reference code, e.g. NBO-COUR-4821.

estimatedDelivery.description: Estimated delivery window or signed delivery confirmation note.

phone.description: Kenyan mobile number for courier and M-Pesa.

address.description: Building, road, or landmark delivery address.

paymentMethod.description: Settlement method: M-Pesa or Cash on Delivery.

items.description: Serialized list of purchased items with product, variant, nibSize, and quantity.

timestamp.description: Formatted date/time string when the order was placed.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer order history and live courier tracking records scoped strictly to the authenticated owner (userId == request.auth.uid).
